🕷️ NEW HEROES SPIDER-MAN (FREE!), RAVEN & ATOM EVE! 🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE

Superhero PvP battlegrounds with superpowers, magic and flight!
🕸️ Spider-Man: swing through the city, pull enemies in and stun them with a web spin. FREE for everyone!
🌑 Raven: dark magic bolts, a soul strike that knocks enemies down and a wave that blocks their powers.
💗 Atom Eve: energy bolts, a bubble trap and a giant atomic hammer that grows to reach enemies.

⚔️ Free-for-all battles on the streets or in the sky.
🌀 Also play as Doctor Strange, Jean Grey, Scarlet Witch, Dark Phoenix, Emma Frost, Storm, Agatha Harkness and Invisible Woman.
🪙 Earn coins, unlock heroes and upgrade your powers.
🍬 Collect Halloween candy corn around the city for extra coins.

⭐ Like & favorite for the next update! Join our Roblox community for sneak peeks and events.

Tags: Spider-Man, Raven, Atom Eve, Invincible, Teen Titans, Marvel, Halloween, superheroes, battlegrounds, PvP, magic
